body:
Part of track #51. Decisions settled here.

## What
- `.github/workflows/release.yml` on `v*` tags: run lint+tests, refuse if tag ≠ package.json version, then `npm publish --provenance --access public` using `NPM_TOKEN` (needs `id-token: write`).
- Missing secret ⇒ a clear `::notice::` telling the operator how to create it, and no publish — same graceful pattern as kanban-dispatch.yml; fork-safe.
- **Post-publish verify job**: after publish succeeds, in a clean job with no checkout, run `npx -y hkb@$VERSION version` and `npx -y hkb@$VERSION help` (retry a few times for registry propagation, give up loudly after ~5 min). This is the end-to-end proof that real-world `npx hkb` distribution works, on every release.
- One short `docs/releasing.md`: the operator's two steps (set NPM_TOKEN once; push the tag).

## Done when
Workflow lints/parses, its logic is covered by the same style of tests as test/actions.test.js, docs page exists.
title: Release workflow: tag → npm publish with provenance, then a real npx verify
